item.title: Dem Senator warns of NFL Draft security risks amid Iran war in letter to DHS
item.summary: Sen. John Fetterman asks DHS to raise the security designation for the 2026 NFL Draft in Pittsburgh, citing safety concerns amid the ongoing Iran conflict.

item.title: Iran, proxy militias threaten US universities in Lebanon as Americans urged to flee now
item.summary: Iran and its proxy militias have threatened universities in Lebanon, U.S. officials say, and the State Department warned Americans to depart immediately.

item.title: Truth about Arizona girl found alive decades after vanishing leaves investigator ‘dumbfounded’: report
item.summary: An Arizona cold case was solved after 30 years. Christina Plante, missing since 1994, has been found alive. An investigator says she ran away at age 13.

item.title: Parents of MacDill bomb suspects are illegal immigrants, DHS warns of birthright citizenship dangers
item.summary: DHS announces parents of suspects in the foiled MacDill Air Force Base explosive plot are illegal immigrants who defied a 1998 removal order.

item.title: Common drinking habit may quietly triple risk of advanced liver condition
item.summary: Even occasional binge drinking could triple the risk of advanced liver fibrosis, a new USC study suggests, highlighting the danger of alcohol consumption patterns.

item.title: Newsom office called out for skipping Biden in post missing Obama as past president with 'functioning brain'
item.summary: Critics call out California Gov. Gavin Newsom's office for omitting Joe Biden from a post about missing a president with a "functioning brain," highlighting Barack Obama instead.

item.title: Pritzker calls on Trump officials to testify over ICE crackdown, White House blasts move as ‘political stunt’
item.summary: Illinois Gov. JB Pritzker calls on Trump administration officials to testify before his commission targeting ICE enforcement operations in the state.

item.title: Walmart employee fatally stabbed in random attack by man who allegedly believed victim was a 'demon': police
item.summary: Jordanne Drinkwater was fatally stabbed at a Conway Walmart in what police described as a random attack. The suspect allegedly said he fought a demon.

item.title: Elle Macpherson strips down at 62 for underwear campaign proving why she's called 'The Body'
item.summary: Elle Macpherson, 62, strips down for a new Bonds underwear campaign, showing off her toned physique and celebrating her cheeky "real self" philosophy.
